schemaVersion.description: Generator schema version, always the component id.

title.description: Short title for students in plain text.

algorithmName.description: The page own name for the algorithm, 1 to 60 characters, a whole phrase in the quote, for example binary search.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It names and/or describes the algorithm; it contains algorithmName.

input.description: Input array of 4 to 10 integers 0 to 99; a search needs ascending distinct values.

target.description: Search target 0 to 99; 0 is the absent sentinel when hasTarget is false.

id.description: Lowercase kebab claim id, 40 characters or fewer.

text.description: Page-stated fact in plain text, 1 to 80 characters. It occurs in the claim quote after whitespace normalisation.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It contains the claim text.
